g.text: New Store Admin? Create Admin Account
Live store metrics — revenue, low stock and payment distribution.
POS terminal — live cart, automatic GST, split payments, instant PDF.
Search product by name, SKU, or barcode…
These fields print on every GST invoice PDF. · Admin-only screen.

svg.text: Sign in — JWT auth, three roles (Admin / Manager / Staff)
Dashboard — revenue, payment split, low stock, top sellers
Products — price, GST, HSN, low-stock threshold; search name / SKU / barcode
Purchases — supplier orders, GST, status & balance due (stock in)
Stock & Movements — full in / out / adjustment audit ledger
Billing / POS — cart, per-line GST, customer, split payment
GST invoice PDF — CGST / SGST split per line, generated on checkout
Sales History — every bill, filter by status, re-download the invoice
Store Settings — shop profile & invoice numbering feed the PDF
User Management — roles & branches; RBAC enforced on API + UI
